# Sarah Ateia Khattab, M.S., LPC Associate, NCC, supervised by Don Zablosky, LPC-S

> Holistic, grounding counseling outdoors in Dallas–Fort Worth parks (based in Irving, TX) and by telehealth across Texas, in English and Arabic. Self-pay, $100 per session, with reduced rates available based on household income. Free 15-minute phone consultation.

## Practice details

- Credentials: Licensed Professional Counselor Associate (LPC Associate) #104391, Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council; National Certified Counselor (NCC) #1746909, NBCC
- Supervision: practices under the supervision of Don Zablosky, LPC-S
- Education: M.S., Psychology (Counseling & Human Development), Texas Woman's University; B.S., Psychology, The University of Texas at Dallas
- Welcomes clients of every culture, language, faith or none, gender, sexual orientation, age, body, ability, and background
- Areas served: Irving, Las Colinas, Coppell, Grand Prairie, Carrollton, Farmers Branch, Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Garland, Mesquite, Wilmer (TX), and all of Texas by telehealth
- Formats: in-person sessions held outdoors in a Dallas–Fort Worth park chosen with the client (walking or seated; no office), with a signed outdoor-session consent form and a telehealth fallback for bad weather; telehealth for clients located in Texas at the time of each session
- Languages: English, Arabic
- Fees: self-pay only, no insurance billing; standard fee $100 per session; optional packages of 6 sessions for $540 ($90 each) or 8 sessions for $640 ($80 each), with unused sessions refunded at the package rate; reduced rates available based on household income; clients may request a Good Faith Estimate
- Areas of focus: anxiety and stress, low mood, emotional overwhelm, nervous system regulation, relationship patterns, burnout, identity and self-understanding, self-esteem, genetics-informed psychoeducation (educational only, not medical advice)
- Contact: (972) 482-9526 · attya.llc@gmail.com
- Business entity: Attya LLC

## Important

- Not a crisis service. In crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or go to the nearest emergency room. Dallas–Fort Worth crisis lines: https://www.sarahateia.com/crisis/
- Genetics-related discussion is educational only, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment; no lab ordering or interpretation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sarahateia.com/): about, approach, how to get started, FAQ, disclosures
- [Counseling in Arabic](https://www.sarahateia.com/arabic-counseling/): sessions in Arabic or English in Dallas–Fort Worth and across Texas
- [Outdoor counseling](https://www.sarahateia.com/outdoor-counseling/): walk and talk or seated sessions in a park, and how privacy, weather, and consent work
- [Telehealth counseling](https://www.sarahateia.com/telehealth-counseling/): sessions for clients located in Texas
- [Optional screening tools](https://www.sarahateia.com/screening-tools/): links to free official questionnaires (PHQ-9, GAD-7, ASRS v1.1, PC-PTSD-5); nothing is collected on the site
- [Resources](https://www.sarahateia.com/resources/): plain-language guides on consultations, LPC Associates, outdoor counseling, choosing a counselor, ADHD, attachment styles, healing after abuse, and self-care
- [How do I find a therapist who respects my Muslim faith?](https://www.sarahateia.com/resources/therapist-who-respects-muslim-faith/): finding a counselor who respects your faith and culture, what holistic, mind-body counseling and grounding look like, and what research says about sleep, movement, breathing, and nature (general counseling, not religious counseling)
- [What are some creative strategies for adults with ADHD?](https://www.sarahateia.com/resources/adhd-creative-strategies/): practical, creative strategies for time, tasks, and stress, and where the body and counseling fit in (educational only, not a diagnosis)
- [How do attachment styles affect relationships?](https://www.sarahateia.com/resources/attachment-styles-in-relationships/): secure, anxious, avoidant, and disorganized patterns and how people move toward more secure relating
- [How do you heal after an abusive relationship?](https://www.sarahateia.com/resources/healing-after-an-abusive-relationship/): safety resources, common reactions, and steps that support recovery
- [What does self-care for mental health actually look like?](https://www.sarahateia.com/resources/self-care-for-mental-health/): research-informed self-care, a holistic check-in, and grounding for hard days
- [Glossary](https://www.sarahateia.com/glossary/): common counseling words in English and Arabic
- [Crisis resources](https://www.sarahateia.com/crisis/): 24/7 crisis lines for Dallas–Fort Worth
